says: Scene 4: a pilgrim striding into the wind, seen three-quarters on, staff planted ahead, the other arm swinging back, cloak streaming behind, walking under the arching ribs of a giant fossil creature. This time I loaded the costume: a hood with a beaded rim, a tunic with stitched seams, a cross-stitched worn patch, a disc ornament on a cord, a beaded belt, a diamond-bordered skirt, cross-wrapped leggings, strapped boots, and a cloak with a band of triangles along its hem. The ground carries a trail of footprints winding back to the horizon, cracked earth, pebbles and tufts instead of horizontal lines.
